goal: Build a continuous MCP discovery feeder daemon that sources new MCP server candidates from npm (keyword: 'mcp-server'), GitHub (topic: 'mcp-server'), and the mcp.so registry, deduplicates against existing mcp_server_registry entries, and writes new candidates to the registry with status='PENDING_SCAN'. Must run every 30 minutes, log discovery counts per source, and emit a mesh_event of type='discovery_batch' with candidate count on each cycle. Target: feed 500+ new unique MCPs per day to keep signal_analyser queue non-empty toward the 20k assessed MCPs goal.
constraints: Deduplicate by server_id (blake2s hash of name+url)
Write via WriteService POST /write not direct DuckDB
Must not re-queue already scored servers (trust_score IS NOT NULL)
Rate limit: max 60 npm API calls per minute
success_criteria: signal_analyser log shows scored servers (not 'No unscored servers found')
error_handling: Log failures per source, continue with remaining sources, never crash the daemon
